interpretations: Group results by the name of their matching race, combining races with the same name across years. For each name, calculate total result points and average result laps. Keep names whose point total exceeds the average point total across all names, then return one row containing the sum of the kept totals, the equally weighted average of their average laps, and their average excess over the all-name average point total.
queries:
WITH race_names AS (
    SELECT r.name,
           SUM(res.points) AS total_points,
           AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS average_laps
    FROM results AS res
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    GROUP BY r.name
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_total_points
    FROM race_names
)
SELECT SUM(rn.total_points),
       AVG(rn.average_laps),
       AVG(rn.total_points - o.average_total_points)
FROM race_names AS rn
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE rn.total_points > o.average_total_points
